value.message: Nothing for underwater basket weaving, but the Town of Halton Hills runs Parent and Tot swim lessons: Parent and Tot 2 (12 to 24 months) and 3 (2 to 3 years) at Acton Lion's Indoor Pool and Gellert, fall term Oct 3 to Dec 3 at Acton for $86.22 for 9 lessons - I could not get into their page today, so that is from their site's listing.
